headline: Activity was enough (Hp30 max 1.3, 0.5 needed in Tromsø), but no aurora in the cameras' checks, several an hour (clouds or moon)
text: Last night: Activity was enough (Hp30 max 1.3, 0.5 needed in Tromsø), but no aurora in the cameras' checks, several an hour (clouds or moon); Tromsø clear 01–02, 03–08, Alta clear 19–05, 07–08
